source: Illinois Department of Public Health, Injury Deaths by Resident County and Intent, Illinois Residents 2010-2019 and 2020-2023 (PDF tables; originals under sources/il_idph)
note: Counts of 0-9 published exactly for all 102 counties; no suppression rule stated on the tables. Sections: all injuries, accidents (unintentional), suicides, homicides. Chicago and Suburban Cook sub-rows ignored (Cook = county total). Suicide here replaces the bad 2011 column in the leading-causes tables.
